title: 2 Miles to Downtown | Rooftop | 3BR | 2,300 SQF
description:
Superhost for 5 years brings you this Beautiful luxurious NEW townhouse with an AMAZING Nashville Skyline view ROOFTOP

- 2 Miles to Downtown Nashville
- 2,100 SQF with a large space for 10 guests comfortably 
- Fully equipped kitchen, 4 smart TVs with cables
- High-speed internet
- 2 car garages
- Huge Rooftop with smart TV, comfortable patio furniture, chaise lounges, and hammock. Breathtaking Skyline view
- $7-10 Uber/Lyft rides to Broadway and all the hot locations in Nashville

The space
Modern 2,300 SQF Townhouse, 3 stories, rooftop with AMAZING Nashville skyline,  big open space, lots of light

Bed configuration - 
Downstairs bedroom 1 - 2  Full  Beds with full bath
Upstairs bedroom 2 - 2 Queen Beds with HUGE full bath
Upstairs bedroom 3 - 1 King Bed - with full bath
Living Room - 2 Queen pullout sofa beds
2 extra folding bed 

This place has been planned thinking about you, the guest. Not one detail was overlooked. This house is straight out of a magazine! 

You'll enjoy:

Guest access
You will receive a welcome message with all the necessary information including the access codes 48 hours before your arrival.

Other things to note
* GREAT FOR LARGE GROUPS *
We own the whole complex. There are 5 side by side large beautiful NEW townhomes with the capability of holding up to 50 guests. Each house has 3 bedrooms and 3.5 baths. We have accommodations that can fit any group size, so please inquire and we will find the best option for you!
